feed.title: Xuwei Guo
feed.subtitle: Personal academic homepage of Xuwei Guo, a Ph.D. student in Software Engineering at Universiti Kebangsaan Malaysia. His research focuses on AI-driven software engineering, explainable artificial intelligence, story point estimation, and software effort and cost estimation.
